t2.thesis: CIFR enters earnings after a roughly 50% monthly collapse driven by a convertible-note raise and dilution, with high short interest and a large implied move, so the reaction is close to a coin flip with a slight lean to a relief bounce.
reasons: Stock is down ~72% from its 52w high and ~49% in a month, so bad news is largely priced in and short interest is 27% of float, which leaves room for a squeeze or relief move.
The Barber Lake extension (+$5.2B contracted revenue) and Black Pearl rent commencement are real fundamental positives, and analysts are bullish (rec mean 1.4).
The last four prints had positive raw returns in 3 of 4 (win rate 0.75) despite EPS misses, because the market trades on HPC leasing news, not EPS.
The overhang is real: heavy dilution (40.7M shares exchanged), a rate-hike scare hitting debt-heavy AI data center names, negative EPS revisions, and revenue down 43% year over year.
The entry open is Oct 30 and the exit is the Nov 2 open, so the holding period includes a weekend, plus the Oct 30 move, with an 18% implied move giving a symmetric wide distribution.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management gives new lease signings or Q4 rent commencement and financing clarity that eases dilution and rate fears for the HPC build-out.
